messages:
Aisha (AE): Heads up - the prospect (FinHealth) dropped their RFI this morning, due EOD tomorrow. They want our completed capability matrix + answers to security sections. Anyone able to take lead on the RFI?
Marco (SE): I can take the capability matrix and technical Qs. Do we have a current CSV/xlsx for features vs competitors?
Dana (SalesOps): I uploaded last quarter's matrix here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1example - it's the 'sales-capability-matrix-q4.xlsx' file. Update as needed.
Aisha (AE): Thanks Dana. Marco, please highlight Dedicated/Private differences & rollout SLAs - FinHealth cares about data residency.
Marco (SE): Will do. Quick Q: they asked about "automated prefix caching and KV cache reuse" - do we have a one-line capability statement?
Priya (Security): Short answer: supported. Longer: prefix/KV caching implemented in runtime, can be disabled per-tenant; caching keys are ephemeral and never stored outside customer's region for Private deployments. I'll draft a security-approved phrasing for the RFI.
Aisha (AE): @Priya awesome - can you also confirm SOC2/ISO items and KMS integrations? They listed KMS/HSM and audit log retention requirements.
Priya (Security): SOC2 Type II - yes. ISO27001 in progress but not yet certified. KMS integrations: AWS KMS and GCP KMS supported; HSM via Bring-Your-Own for Private. Audit logs: 13 months by default, configurable. I'll add exact clause.
Dana (SalesOps): Pricing note: they asked for Dedicated reserved pricing + POC pricing. For a 90-day POC we typically offer a dev-reserved slab at 30% of list for proofing. If they convert to Dedicated commit, we credit the POC fees. Put that in pricing appendix.
Carl (Solutions): For the POC technical plan: propose 2-week integration + 6-week tuning; deliverables: initial throughput baseline, latency SLO report, and model-quality checks. Will need a Redwood SE and FinHealth infra contact.
Aisha (AE): FinHealth contact is Elena Morales (email on CRM). I'll intro. Need to align on test dataset scope - they require production-like PII masked set.
Marco (SE): On model variants: recommend 2 variants - quantized low-cost and full FP32 quality. I'll add a small table comparing latency/cost for 128/512 seq lengths.
Dana (SalesOps): Pricing appendix: include per-token hosted API, and per-GPU-hour Dedicated rates. Use current ratecard v3.2 (I'll attach).
redwood-bot: Attachment uploaded: sales-capability-matrix-q4.xlsx
Priya (Security): Drafted responses to the security questionnaire - putting it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1secQexample (section headers: Data residency, Access control, Incident response, Encryption, Logging). Please review.
Marco (SE): Patch to capability matrix: added rows for KV caching, fallback routing, quantization profiles, SLOs. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1example (file updated).
Aisha (AE): Great. Can we also include a short appendix showing prior customer POC results (anonymized)? That helps close.
Carl (Solutions): I have a one-page anonymized case: reduced per-token cost 3x during steady-state using caching + batching. I'll paste the summary into the RFI appendix.
Dana (SalesOps): Final reminder: RFI needs to be a single pdf + capability matrix xlsx. I'll assemble the packet once everyone flags ready. Deadline for edits: 12:00pm tomorrow.
Marco (SE): Will finish matrix + technical narrative tonight, flag when ready for review.
Priya (Security): I'll finish security Q responses by 9am tomorrow and share for sign-off.
Aisha (AE): Perfect. I'll do the customer intro and collect the POC stakeholder list. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Marco (SE): Quick snippet I'll include in RFI under "fallbacks": `If primary model pool is unavailable, requests route to a compatible quantized variant with documented latency delta <= 25%`
Dana (SalesOps): Noted - include conversion credit language for the POC.
redwood-bot: Reminder set by Aisha: RFI assemble deadline 1713091200 (tomorrow noon).
